claim_boundary.permitted_if_passed: On the frozen v7 finite-pool evaluation of four measured OER composition plates, v10 required fewer additional result queries than every preregistered baseline while preserving success-rate and per-plate guardrails, and preregistered composition descriptors passed paired ablation.
not_permitted: The same reduction applies to another material, formulation, factory, process, or objective.
Finite-pool replay proves continuous-space, prospective-experiment, or production-cycle reduction.
The composition descriptors are validated physical laws or confirmed causes.
A passing v7 result deletes, overrides, or reinterprets failed v3, v4, or v6 evidence.
Thresholds, budgets, features, baselines, units, or pass gates may change after outcome access.
